clarified_messages.content: Hi Marcus, thanks for coming in. Are you here already or still downstairs?
I'm just arriving, waiting by the fountain. Should I come up now?
Yes, just take the elevator to the third floor—I'm in my office, right by the nurses' station.
Okay, I'm on my way.
I'm here now. Should I check in at the desk or come straight?
Just come in, they're expecting you.
Alright, found your office! Thanks.
Let’s start. About your new medication—when did you last take it?
Last night, around 9. Is that too late?
It's fine for now, but I’d like you to shift to mornings. Take it after breakfast, around 8.
Okay, so tomorrow morning?
Exactly. And start using the symptom tracker app after each dose.
Which app is that? The one we set up last visit?
Yes, SymptoLog. I sent you the invite last week. Do you still have her contact info if you need technical help?
I think so. Is that the coordinator from IT?
Yes, Kara at extension 822.
Great, I’ll reach out if I get stuck.
Now, about your next bloodwork—we’ll do it here on your follow-up. That's scheduled for then, right?
I see a 10 AM appointment next Tuesday. Is that correct?
Yes, that's then. You'll go to the lab on the second floor. The staff will be waiting.
Is that the same lab as last time?
Yes, just follow the signs for 'Clinical Pathology.' Remember to bring that document I gave you—your pre-authorization.
Oh, I have it in my bag.
Perfect. Now, for the specialist referral—I’ve contacted her already and she'll call you tomorrow.
Which specialist is this again?
Dr. Patel, the rheumatologist. Her clinic is across from this building.
Got it. Should I wait for her call or reach out myself?
Wait for her call. If she doesn’t reach you by then, let me know.
When exactly should I expect the call?
Tomorrow between noon and two.
Okay, I’ll keep my phone on.
Also, bring that folder with your insurance info for your visit.
Will do. Is it the blue one or the red one?
The red one—the blue is for pharmacy receipts.
Okay, thanks. For the medication, do I need to pick up the next batch from there or will it be mailed?
This time, pick it up at the hospital pharmacy. I’ll send in the prescription today.
Cool. Is it the same pharmacy as before?
Yes, just down the hallway past the cafeteria.
Great, I know where that is.
Any issues with allergies since then?
No, nothing new since my last dose.
And how about the injection site—any swelling there?
A bit, but nothing major. Should I send a photo?
Yes, upload it via the app, and I’ll review it after clinic hours.
Got it. Will my info on there be private?
Absolutely—it's encrypted and only accessible by your care team.
Thanks for clarifying! By the way, did you enjoy the coffee from the lounge this morning?
Haha, yes—it’s better than usual.
Nice! So, to confirm—take the meds at 8, symptoms in the app, bloodwork next week, Dr. Patel calls tomorrow, pharmacy pickup here, right?
Exactly. Let me know if anything changes or if you need help.
I will. Thanks again, Dr. Chen.
Of course. See you next week!
